recipes.title: HOT FUDGE ICE CREAM BAR DESSERT
recipes.shortHook: Crispy, golden, and dusted with powdered sugar — carnival perfection straight from your own kitchen.

ingredients.name: 1 (12 oz) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

method: Pour the chocolate syrup into a medium microwave-safe bowl and microwave until hot, about 2 minutes on high, stopping every 30 seconds. Do not allow to boil. Stir peanut butter into hot chocolate until smooth. Allow to cool to room temperature.

Line the bottom of a 9x13-inch dish with a layer of ice cream sandwiches. Spread half the whipped topping over the sandwiches. Spoon half the chocolate mixture over that. Top with half the peanuts. Repeat layers. Freeze until firm, at least 1 hour. Cut into squares to serve.

recipes.title: CARAMEL APPLE MAGIC FRIDGE CAKE
recipes.shortHook: Crispy, golden, and dusted with powdered sugar — carnival perfection straight from your own kitchen.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup store-bought caramel sauce, such as Smucker’s

method: Beat heavy cream, apple pie spice, and 3 tablespoons of the caramel sauce with an electric mixer on medium speed until stiff peaks form, about 2 minutes; set aside.

Crush 6 of the graham cracker squares in a medium bowl; set aside. Spread 1/3 cup of the whipped cream on a long platter in an 8-inch-long and 3-inch-thick line. Working with one cracker at a time, spread about 1 tablespoon of the whipped cream to cover one side of the cracker. Dollop with about 1 teaspoon of the apple jelly and stand vertically on the prepared platter. Repeat with remaining crackers, pressing each cracker against the previous one to create a log. Frost top and sides of log with remaining whipped cream mixture. Insert several toothpicks into log and cover with a large bowl; refrigerate for at least 6 hours or up to 8 hours.
Drizzle chilled log with remaining 1 tablespoon caramel sauce. Press reserved crushed graham crackers gently around sides of the cake. Slice on a diagonal to see all the layers.

recipes.title: CRAB RANGOON NACHOS
recipes.shortHook: Rich, satisfying, and effortless. Restaurant-quality flavors made right at home.

ingredients.name: 1 (8 oz) pkg imitation leg crabmeat, finely shredded and roughly chopped
1/2 cup thinly sliced scallions (from 1 bunch), plus more for garnish
1 tsp fresh lemon juice (from 1 small lemon)
1/2 tsp grated fresh garlic (from 1 medium clove)

method: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) with racks in the upper and lower third positions. Coat 2 large rimmed baking sheets with cooking spray. Cut wonton wrappers in half on the diagonal to create triangles. Arrange in a single layer on prepared baking sheets; coat with cooking spray.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden and crisp, 6 to 8 minutes, rotating baking sheets top to bottom and back to front halfway through. Let cool on baking sheets slightly, about 5 minutes.
Stir together crabmeat, cream cheese, scallions, Sriracha, soy sauce, lemon juice, sugar, garlic powder, grated garlic, and salt in a bowl until combined.
Arrange baked wonton chips in an even layer on a large rimmed baking sheet. Dollop crab mixture evenly over chips.
Bake on upper third rack in preheated oven until crab mixture is warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Remove from the oven, drizzle evenly with sweet chili sauce, and garnish with additional scallions, cilantro, jalapenos, and sesame seeds, as desired. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: GARLIC BUTTER STEAK BITES & HERB POTATOES
recipes.shortHook: Loaded skillet dinner packed with 10 savory ingredients. Tender steak and crispy garlic potatoes.
method: Parboil potatoes for 5 mins then sauté in olive oil until golden brown.
Season cubed steak generously with salt, cracked pepper, and paprika.
Sear steak on high heat for 3-4 mins until crust forms.
Add butter, smashed garlic, rosemary, and thyme; baste everything for 2 mins.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot from the skillet.

recipes.title: CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BURRITO BOWL
recipes.shortHook: 12 ingredients, multi-step meal prep powerhouse. High protein, huge volume, under 500 cals.
method: Blend chipotle peppers, honey, lime juice, and spices to create marinade.
Toss chicken breast in sauce and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat for 6 mins per side until charred.
Rest cooked chicken for 5 minutes then dice into bite-sized cubes.
Portion cilantro lime rice into 5 meal prep bowls.
Layer with black beans, sweet corn, pico de gallo, and diced chicken.
Top with fresh avocado, cotija cheese, and a drizzle of Greek yogurt crema.
